candidates.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI
candidates.summary: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.
